samples.summary: clearFormatting hand-rolls the link-trailing-edge exit instead of reusing the existing `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` helper
samples.evidence: `TextEditor.exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` (text-editor.ts:5935) already encodes "stage the visual style with `href: undefined` when the caret sits at a link's trailing edge", and every other exit path (Enter/Space/paste) goes through it. `clearFormatting` instead re-implements that decision inline (`isAtLinkTrailingEdge(...) || (prev && 'href' in prev && prev.href === undefined)` then a bespoke `{ ...CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE, href: undefined }` set), so there are now two encodings of the same rule that can drift — the same drift the issue's own plan ("one list, three entry points") was fixing for the key list. Setting the pending style and then calling `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge(this.cursor.position)` would reuse the helper, since it merges pending over the caret style.

samples.summary: `removeLink` added as an optional member of the shared `TextFormattingEditor` contract even though every implementer supplies it, weakening the shared surface
samples.evidence: types.ts declares `removeLink?(): void` and the consumer calls `editor.removeLink?.()` (text-format-group.tsx:167), yet both implementers provide it unconditionally: `EditorAPI.removeLink` (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:217, impl :3696) and `SlidesTextBoxEditor.removeLink` (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:270/650), as does the visual-harness stub (slides-scenarios.tsx:1680). Sibling commands with identical reach (`requestLink`, `clearInlineFormatting`) are required members; making this one optional means a future surface that forgets it silently renders a dead button rather than failing type-check — and packages/frontend has no `tsc` lane to catch either shape.

samples.evidence: `TextFormatGroup` is rendered without `showLink={false}`, so slides keeps `InsertLinkButton` → `editor.requestLink()` → `SlidesTextBoxEditor.requestLink` (packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:656) → docs `api.requestLink`, whose `onLinkRequest` this delta explicitly re-confirms as unwired (`slides-view.tsx`: "Cmd+K no-ops at the editor level until then, so *inserting* a link here is not yet possible"). The delta adds a live Remove-link button immediately beside a dead Insert-link button on both slides surfaces (text-edit-section.tsx:89-94, mobile-toolbar.tsx:576-581) — a surface-fit inconsistency the same change had the information to resolve (e.g. hide Insert link on slides until the anchor exists).

samples.summary: Slides Remove-link UI is scope beyond issue #1051's stated plan/acceptance criteria
samples.evidence: The issue todo (docs/tasks/active/20260908-docs-clear-formatting-keeps-links-todo.md) lists five plan steps and five acceptance criteria, all about `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE`, the Cmd+\ shortcut, contract comments, the design-doc note and tests; the only removal criterion is "`removeLink` is still the way to drop a hyperlink", which already holds.
